svg.aria-label: Measured numerical data redrawn from Ramaye et al., NIST SP260-208, Table E1.1 and Tables 11–12. Fifteen datasets from 12 laboratories, six aliquot means each. Gold: aliquot means; blue: mean ± 1 sample SD; band: certified mobility ± expanded uncertainty (k=2). L11a–d are different configurations from one laboratory. B contains certification uncertainty components, not laboratory error bars. Published numerical facts are transcribed into an original plot.
